summary: Official Augsburg and Bavarian surveying sources were found. The open ALKIS-Parzellarkarte WMS returned a bounded Augsburg map image, but no parcel IDs or vector geometry. The official ALKIS WFS, INSPIRE parcel WFS/WMS, and coordinate lookup are authenticated/licensed or require a personal token; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and German first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-5134-augsburg.json. They located the local Augsburg surveying office, City Geodatenamt, BayernAtlas, Geoportal Bayern catalogue, and LDBV service pages.
requestOutcomes: All requests used browser-like User-Agent, Accept, German Accept-Language, cookies where applicable, viewer Referer for service calls, TLS verification, and bounded extents. The open raster WMS capabilities and Augsburg GetMap succeeded. Authenticated vector candidates returned 401; the documented coordinate route returned 404 without its required token. No credentials, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, TLS disablement, owner/address/titleholder/tax/contact fields, or formal extract request was used.
scopeLimits: The local office and city Geodatenamt establish cadastral custodianship and procedures, not anonymous vector access.
The open WMS is a reduced raster portrayal and explicitly omits parcel numbers and boundary markers; it cannot yield safe native parcel identity or retained polygon geometry.
The Bavaria-wide claim for authenticated ALKIS vector services was not converted into an open citywide parcel source claim.
The exact WUP point was preserved and used inside a small bounded WMS extent; authentication walls and the 404 lookup response were not treated as parcel presence or absence.
No GeoJSON sample was retained because no safe native parcel ID plus full polygon response was obtained.
This packet is research evidence only and must not be treated as source integration or adapter admission.
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was returned anonymously. Do not synthesize one from raster pixels, response order, WMS layer names, or internal row numbers.

nativeFieldMapping.mappingStatus: schema not retrieved because vector endpoints require authentication

crs: Open raster WMS capabilities: EPSG:4326 among supported CRSs. Authenticated ALKIS WFS documentation: EPSG:25832 default, also EPSG:25833, EPSG:4258, EPSG:4326, EPSG:3857.
geometryQuality: Raster map image only; vector geometry not evaluated.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review and adapter qualification still required
uncertainty: A licensed or authenticated vector service may support Augsburg parcels, and the open raster confirms visual parcel-boundary depiction. Public vector schema, stable native identity, licensing for reuse, and anonymous runtime access remain unresolved.
